notes:
When you ask the coding agent for more than one file (a script and the page that loads it, say) and it stops after writing the first, it now sees which of the files you named are still missing and goes back to write them. Those tasks take longer than before, because the agent finishes the job instead of stopping partway.

Outlier's upgrade windows now show the price you pay at checkout: $16.99 once through December 2, then $29. Before, they still said $24.50.
